offset.description: Token index where this passage begins in the full text (index of the first token)

length.description: Length of the passage in tokens

segments.description: Ordered paragraph blocks of display text

label.description: Optional display label only (e.g. line number); not a literary type

text.description: Display base text including spaces and punctuation

end.description: Inclusive end token index (work-level); must be >= start

offset.description: Token index from the beginning of the full text (not a UTF-16 code unit)

content.description: Lexical form; must equal segment.text.slice(charStart, charEnd)

charStart.description: Inclusive start into the containing segment text (JS UTF-16)

charEnd.description: Exclusive end into the containing segment text (JS UTF-16)

transliteration.description: Latin-alphabet phonetic rendering (pinyin, romaji, etc.); may be empty

id.description: Stable identity within the work (authoring / selection key)

end.description: Inclusive end token index; must be >= start

content.description: Text of the gloss (grammar, commentary, etc.)
